_comment: Prompt language for each fidelity axis, by band. A hold of 1.0 means keep the seed card's version of that aspect; 0.0 means it may change completely. Edit freely - this file is the wording, not the mechanism. Bands are matched by the first entry whose 'upto' is >= the value.

structure.text: Take only the subject matter from image 1. Compose the scene anew.
Keep only the subject of image 1 and its essential gesture; recompose everything around it.
Keep the overall arrangement of image 1 and the placement of its principal figure, but recompose the surrounding detail freely.
Follow the composition of image 1 closely; small adjustments to spacing and framing are permitted.
Hold the composition of image 1 exactly: figure placement, proportion, perspective and gesture must not move.

style.text: Discard the rendering of image 1 entirely and adopt the reference style.
Re-render in the reference style; keep only a trace of image 1's handling.
Blend image 1's handling with the reference style.
Largely preserve image 1's line quality and surface, inflected by the reference.
Preserve the rendering of image 1: its line quality, mark-making and surface texture.

colour.text: Take the palette from the reference. The colour of image 1 is not to be preserved.
Move the palette decisively toward the reference.
Meet image 1's palette and the reference's halfway.
Keep image 1's palette, warmed or cooled slightly toward the reference.
Keep the palette of image 1 exactly: the same hues, the same values.

lighting.text: Relight the scene freely; ignore the light in image 1.
Relight the scene, keeping only its general time of day.
Keep the light direction of image 1 but restate its key and contrast.
Keep image 1's light direction and key; contrast may shift.
Keep the light of image 1: its direction, key, contrast and cast shadows.

iconography.text: Re-imagine this card's symbolism from its title and meaning. Do not copy the symbols in image 1.
Substitute new symbols for those in image 1, keeping the card's meaning.
Keep the card's principal symbol from image 1 and replace the secondary ones.
Keep the symbolic content of image 1, allowing minor attributes to vary.
Keep every symbolic element of image 1 exactly: each attribute, creature and object.
